job_title: On-Site Entry-Level Software Developer – NAS/FAA STARS
job_description:
A leading government contractor in Egg Harbor Township, NJ, is seeking an entry-level Software Developer. The role involves software development, testing, and providing engineering support for the Standard Terminal Automation Replacement System (STARS). Candidates must have a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field and knowledge of programming languages such as C/C++, Java, and SQL. The position is on-site and involves occasional travel.
